title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Thread relief groove geometry and dimensions
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow dimensional specifications based on diameter ranges (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm)
Thread relief grooves must be made when thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove geometry includes specific radius, width, and depth dimensions based on diameter/pitch
Designs must compare against UNI4386 standard specifications
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: Diameter range 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4-2.0mm, radius R 0.1
Diameter range 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6-1.8mm, radius R 1.6
Diameter range 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.8-2.9mm, radius R 2.5
Diameter range >125mm: width 7mm, depth 1.1-5.1mm, radius R4.0
Thread relief groove pitch P≤1.25: R=1.2, A=3.3, B=1.2, T1=0.2, T2=1.2
Thread relief groove pitch P=1.5-1.75-2: R=1.6, A=4.0, B=1.2, T1=0.2, T2=1.7
Thread relief groove pitch P=2.5-3: R=2.0, A=5.0, B=1.5, T1=0.3, T2=2.4
tolerances: Grinding groove width tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.3 depending on diameter range
Grinding groove depth tolerance: ±0.1 to ±0.3 depending on diameter range
Thread groove profile tolerance: 3.2 surface angle specification
Thread groove depth tolerance: P-0.6 to 3
surface_finish: Thread relief groove includes 3.2 surface finish specification on chamfer angles
inspection: Verify groove dimensions match diameter/pitch range specifications
Compare groove geometry against UNI4386 standard where applicable
Confirm groove details are indicated in drawing details
Check radius, width, depth, and positional tolerances
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing clearance
Thread grooves executed when thread terminates at shoulder with ledge function
Specific grooves may require detail callouts on drawings beyond standard specifications
Both UNI regulation and TRASMITAL specifications apply
training_guidance: NX agent must recognize diameter ranges and automatically select appropriate grinding relief groove dimensions
When modeling threaded shafts terminating at shoulders, agent should add relief groove per thread pitch
Agent should validate groove geometry against both UNI4386 standard and TRASMITAL internal specifications
Relief grooves are mandatory features for grinding zones and thread terminations at shoulders
Agent must include groove detail callouts in generated drawings with specific dimensions
Use lookup table based on pitch (P) to determine R, A, B, T1, T2 parameters for thread relief grooves
Apply appropriate tolerances based on diameter range for grinding grooves and specified tolerances for thread grooves
summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones and TAB-002 for thread terminations. Grinding relief grooves are dimensioned based on four diameter ranges (18-50, 51-80, 81-125, >125mm) with specific width, depth, radius, and tolerance values, compared against UNI4386 standard. Thread relief grooves are required when threads end at shoulders, with geometry (R, A, B, T1, T2) determined by thread pitch (P), ranging from P≤1.25 to P=2.5-3.
